note: which artifact answers which task family, and the floor each is judged against. the package ships the readers; this file says where this cohort's numbers live. promote computes candidates, intervals, floors and outcomes from these; notes and caveats are taken from a person at the gate.

cross_modal_retrieval.metric: AUC, matched vs mismatched pairs, cross-subarray patient-held-out

tissue_state_grouping.metric: KMeans ARI against mc_megacluster, niche level

floor.basis: mc_coherence.parquet raw_st row - the molecular modality alone

subject_identity_suppression.metric: bio/patient ratio = TIME-signature z / patient-identity z, z_he, 10k permutations

floor.basis: measured, not cited: every run's eval/biology.parquet carries the raw_he view of the same test. identical across arms because the morphology input is.

pathway_transfer.metric: testable pathways significant under BH-FDR on held-out subjects, z_he view

floor.basis: no pathway survives BH-FDR on held-out subjects

morphology_decode.metric: univariate CCA z vs permutation null, TLS gene signature, cross-patient, BH-FDR<0.05

floor.basis: does not survive BH-FDR on held-out subjects; z is set to 0 there

structural_agreement.not_available: reported, not routed: CKA and alignment gap are read from eval/H1/summary.json as descriptive geometry, with no floor declared that would make one arm the answer to a question

pathway_discrimination.not_available: the v3 DAG decomposition is deferred; the report, deck and session record disagree on the numbers. resolve to one artifact before this row exists
